_comment: spec-v637 §2: stable-id alias map for the MCP surface. Tile ids are a public API an agent may hardcode; when a shipped id is RETIRED it is mapped here to its canonical successor so callers self-heal. Shape: aliases[oldId] = { canonical: <live id>, since: 'YYYY-MM-DD', sunset: 'YYYY-MM-DD' }. The server resolves an alias to its canonical (attaching a deprecation notice) whenever the canonical is live, regardless of wall-clock (it reads no clock); a maintainer removes the entry after the sunset date. See docs/stability.md. spec-v913 retired four ids that were the same instrument twice; each maps to the fuller twin that survived. spec-v948 retired four more, surfaced once spec-v947 fixed the finder blind spot that had hidden them. spec-v973 retired four more, found by the spec-v972 citation signal rather than by the name.
